title: MyBMW app features and usability
summary: Feedback about the phone app centers on strong praise for remote monitoring and available functions, while complaints focus on poor app quality, difficult setup and activation, and connectivity or integration problems, with many mentions lacking enough detail for clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the smartphone app’s monitoring features and broad functionality.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the app as poor, hard to set up or use, inconsistent in connecting, and frustrating when integrations do not work.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions refer to the app or phone-app features such as preconditioning, phone-based parking, or needing a compatible phone, but the examples do not clearly express sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled mentions are undetermined, so the concrete evidence for clear sentiment is limited.
Several fragments are very short or truncated, which restricts interpretation of the specific app issue or benefit.
The examples mix general app references with distinct functions such as preconditioning, parking, payments, and third-party integration, so not every mention points to the same app experience.
